Maya (Marketing): Quick check after today's webinar: who is owning the recording and lead flow?
Ben (Events): I grabbed the cloud recording. ZoomBot link: https://zoom.us/rec/share/Abc987_demo (passcode: webinar). I'll upload MP4 + captions to drive in 30m.
ZoomBot: Recording finished by host maya@redwood.ai at 2026-03-xx 18:10 UTC.
Iris (Growth): Routing preference: create contacts for all joiners, mark MQL only if watch_pct>=50 or survey_interest=yes. Send engaged leads to Sales queue.
Leo (Sales): Please tag engaged leads with 'webinar:lowlatency' and add 'engaged' if watch_pct>=50. I'll triage those. Also we want a Calendly CTA only for engaged ones.
Maya (Marketing): Draft follow-up email for attendees: "Thanks for joining — recording + benchmark PDF inside. If you watched >50% we'll send a Calendly link to book a demo." Thoughts?
Iris (Growth): Looks good. Add UTM params to the PDF link (utm_campaign=webinar_q1_2026).
Ben (Events): Uploaded files: drive.redwood.ai/webinars/2026-03-lowlatency/master.mp4 and captions.srt. Exported attendee CSV to drive.redwood.ai/exports/lowlatency-attendees.csv
Maya (Marketing): I'll finalize the email and social clips. Iris, can you set the automation to only trigger Calendly webhook for watch_pct>=50?
Iris (Growth): On it. I will also add a 2-question feedback survey to help score interest.
Leo (Sales): Add a simple follow-up task template: subject "Webinar follow-up: low-latency" with bullets: (1) confirm latency needs (2) send benchmark PDF (3) offer 20-min demo.
Maya (Marketing): Perfect. I'll post the final links and templates here when ready. :thumbsup:
